messages:
Sasha M.: quick design review — trying a tighter compact view for the error drilldown; want to check export behavior and a11y before we ship :eyes:
Mike L.: love the compact card idea. main concern: will devs still be able to scan correlation IDs quickly?
Tara (design): thinking: make the corr-id a small pill with copy-on-click + visible hover tooltip that says "copy correlation id". also keyboard focusable.
Oliver (eng): +1 to pill. implementation note: some IDs are long (64 chars). should we truncate visually and copy full id to clipboard?
Sasha M.: yes truncate to 12 chars + ellipsis, but copy full. visible full id on hover.
Tara (design): accessibility: ensure focus outline is high contrast. colors look fine on mac but fail contrast on a11y check (WCAG AA). can we tweak to #0b66ff -> #0350d8?
Mike L.: we can adjust token color. Also file-export: current spec allows CSV/JSON. request: add "JSONL (events)" and "Raw trace bundle (tgz)". default should remain JSON for integrations.
Oliver (eng): JSONL is fine. raw tgz needs signed url generation - adds backend work. can be gated behind a feature flag.
Tara (design): UX for export dropdown: group export types under headings: "line-oriented" (JSONL) and "bundles" (tgz). smaller microcopy: "Download raw trace bundle for offline analysis".
Sasha M.: another UX flow: for long stack traces we should auto-collapse frames that are in vendor packages, show "... 12 frames hidden (expand)" and allow keyboard toggling with Space or Enter.
Oliver (eng): we already have a collapse API, but need a clear affordance and aria-expanded state. will add aria-controls + live region for dynamic reveal.
Tara (design): on the stack frame rows, add a tiny context switcher icon that opens source context (repo + line) in a small popover. ensure popover is accessible (role=dialog, trap focus).
Mike L.: +1 but watch click-target size. mobile touch needs 44px min hit target.
Sasha M.: copy tweaks: replace "Export trace" with "Download trace" in primary action; change "Correlation ID" label to "Trace ID" in the timeline header (we use trace id elsewhere).
Tara (design): microcopy for empty state: "No errors captured for this range. Try widening the time window or enable sampling." — concise and actionable.
Oliver (eng): telemetry: add an event when user copies Trace ID and when they download JSONL. small metric.
Tara (design): one more a11y nit: announce download started in an aria-live polite region so screen readers get feedback.
Sasha M.: okay owners: Oliver -> aria + export backend (flag for tgz), Mike -> color + touch targets, Tara -> final copy and tooltip text, Sasha -> rollup and follow-up with PM.
tracebot: deploy-preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/trace/1772105432 — snapshot build includes the compact-card and pill copy behavior.
Mike L.: testing notes: found keyboard focus lost after export modal closes on Safari. filing a bug in #eng-oncall.
Sasha M.: thanks all — will merge design diff after colors + keyboard fixes. :raised_hands:
